name: oh-my-zcode
description: Evidence-gated ZCode pipeline: separate builders, reviewers and verifiers; PASS requires a matched execution result and unchanged source/artifact fingerprints. Research checks fetched citations; security checks scoped execution and explicit reproduction contracts.

description_i18n.en: Evidence-gated ZCode pipeline: separate builders, reviewers and verifiers; PASS requires a matched execution result and unchanged source/artifact fingerprints. Research checks fetched citations; security checks scoped execution and explicit reproduction contracts.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 证据门控的 ZCode 流水线：构建者、审查者和验证者相互独立；只有执行结果匹配且源代码与产物指纹未变化时才会通过。研究流程核验引用来源，安全流程核验执行范围和明确的复现约定。
